excerpts.author: jtraglia
excerpts.content:
Yes, they should be functionally equivalent. There are two changes which are worth mentioning:
* [Reject pre-Gloas slots using `GLOAS_FORK_EPOCH`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5663) -- This is just an alternate version of [5652](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5652); it's closer to how clients would/should actually implement . I had tried something different in 5652 and it turned out not to work so well, my mistake 🥲 
* [Add test for missing head flag edge case at the fork](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5661) -- A test which all clients _should_ already pass, but worth double checking because if there's a disagreement it could cause a consensus-split at the fork.
